export_scope: Compact projection of completed throughput JSON only; no new measurements, payload reads or workload recomputation.

comparison.scope: Observed whole-cycle elapsed ratios, not isolated optimization causality or equal-work benchmark.

interpretation: The observed aggregate-to-evaluation cycle is shorter with a larger data pool, while collection-to-evaluation is longer. Multiple settings and workloads differ; this does not isolate any optimization or establish eager-loading benefit.

timeline.cycle_definition: aggregate owner start through development stage owner exit; concurrent workers counted once

limitations: Multiple implementation settings, data volume, learning difficulty and cache temperature can differ; rates are descriptive, not causal speedup evidence.
Process read_bytes is per-process kernel accounting; shared I/O attribution cannot be equated with independent physical disk traffic.
An anchor, overlapping legal horizon target slot, full-history observation and legal rear action tick are distinct units.
The collection-to-evaluation envelope may include other registered autonomous/gate work and human review; unclassified gaps are not scheduling losses.
JSON receipt and source bindings are verified here; model, DINO, image and trajectory payloads are not read.

frozen_visual_storage.measurement: Small JSON indexes and filesystem stat only; no payload reread or content revalidation.
frozen_visual_storage.cache_temperature: Unknown. Existing cache files and prior execution do not measure resident OS page-cache warmth.
